Package com.nexuslink.core.env

Class EnvironmentService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.env.EnvironmentService
public final class EnvironmentService extends Object
Owns the user's named environments (dev / staging / prod, …), the currently active one, and an optional .env file, and resolves ${VAR} references against them. Persists the environments to ~/.nexuslink/environments.json.

Resolution precedence, most specific first:

  1. the active environment's variables,
  2. the .env file (~/.nexuslink/.env by default),
  3. the process's system environment (System.getenv(java.lang.String)).
So an environment can override ${BASE_URL} while ${HOME} still falls through to the OS. Unknown names resolve to null (left as a literal ${NAME} by the interpolator).
